name: Dead Weight
source:
During a thick and stormy winter hike, 
Ronan is determined to make it to safety. 
But there is one thing weighing him down. 
 
Will he continue to carry it ?
Or will he go on without it?

[From [url=https://kxaxcy.itch.io/dead-weight]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在风雨交加的冬季徒步旅行中，
罗南决心安全抵达。
但有一件事压垮了他。
 
他会继续背着它吗？
或者他会继续没有它吗？

[来自[url=https://kxaxcy.itch.io/dead-weight]itch.io[/url]]
